QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] Serendipitous Destruction
QuestInfo.0: You notice something shiny in the lightning-charred remains of a tree. Go take a closer look.
QuestInfo.1: You notice something shiny in the lightning-charred remains of a tree. Could it be a #ekey?#n See if you retrieve it from what's left of the tree.
QuestInfo.2: You noticed something shiny in the lightning-charred remains of a tree. You broke it open only to find exactly what you hoped inside. YES! Your first key.\r\nIt looks like the keys could be hidden anywhere, so keep an eye out from now on.\r\n
